'''Juntah Herm''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and an Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Some time after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Juntah Herm was stationed in the [[Imperial Outpost (Dantooine)|Imperial Outpost]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
Juntah Herm first appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' with the release of the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] expansion pack.
